summary: Tested 3 features across backend and frontend: (1) Deployment roster bulk-import CSV endpoint with skip-existing behavior, (2) EMTF/TIFMAS Rank pages Import CSV + Template buttons and Delete button inside edit dialog, (3) Voice Feedback attachments (submit accepts up to 5 files x 10MB, list returns attachments_count, UI shows Add File button after recording and paperclip badge in list). Backend: 7/7 pytest cases PASS. Frontend: all data-testids and UI elements verified present.

critical_code_review_comments: Bulk-import returns non-JSON-serializable safe response but note: existing_names query limited to 1000 entries via to_list(1000). For tenants with >1000 roster entries, duplicates may slip through. Recommend removing the limit or paginating.

Voice feedback attachments are stored as base64 inside the same MongoDB document as audio_data. With 5x10MB attachments + 25MB audio, a single doc can approach the 16MB Mongo document limit and will fail insert. Consider GridFS or object storage.
voice_feedback_routes submit endpoint does not enforce total-attachment aggregate size, only per-file. Combined with above, this is a latent bug.
seed_data_creation: Bulk-import test inserts one TEST_IMPORT_<hex> roster entry per run (not cleaned up). Voice feedback test creates 1 feedback record with 2 attachments per run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 requested features (roster bulk import, EMTF edit delete button, voice feedback attachments) are verified working end-to-end. Add File button in feedback modal is conditionally rendered only after recording captures audioBlob - this is by design. If further UI testing needed for the actual attachment upload flow, use a fake MediaRecorder via Playwright browser context permissions or inject a File via the hidden [data-testid="attachment-input"] element with page.set_input_files after opening the modal (still requires audioBlob state).
